entities.name: P41259 CysRS
observations: Reviewed UniProt reference P41259 is an exact full-length sequence match to the 465-residue query.
Annotated as cysteine--tRNA ligase (CysRS), EC 6.1.1.16, cytosolic and monomeric.
Binds one Zn(2+) ion per subunit.
Contains class-I aminoacyl-tRNA synthetase HIGH region at positions 29–39 and KMSKS region at positions 269–273.
Pfam supports tRNA-synt_1e, tRNA-synt_1g, and DALR_2 domains.

entities.name: Cys-tRNA aminoacylation
observations: Catalyzed reaction: tRNA(Cys) + L-cysteine + ATP = L-cysteinyl-tRNA(Cys) + AMP + diphosphate.
Reaction is assigned EC 6.1.1.16 and Rhea RHEA:17773.

entities.name: Zn2+ cofactor
observations: The curated reference annotation reports binding of one zinc ion per CysRS subunit.
